title: Why Cortana chose Master Chief in Halo
subject: masterchief
description:
Would you still trust Cortana after this? 👇

The hidden origin of Cortana, the AI in Master Chief's helmet. Spoilers for Halo lore.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Halo Studios, Xbox Game Studios or Microsoft. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: The voice in Master Chief's helmet came from a real brain.
On May 21, 2549, Dr. Catherine Halsey cloned herself twenty times for Operation Red Flag.
Two months later, the clones' brains were removed and frozen. The bodies were destroyed.
On November 7, at CASTLE Base on Reach, one of those minds became an AI. She named herself Cortana.
She could have paired with any Spartan. She picked John-117 for his neural compatibility and his uncanny luck.
So every time Chief slots Cortana into his armor, he carries a copy of the woman who took him from his family.
